L.title: UAE Gratuity Calculator
L.disclaimer: For guidance only. Not legal advice. Consult MOHRE or a professional for your specific case.
L.cappedNote: Cap applied: gratuity cannot exceed 2 years' basic salary.
L.notEligible: Service period is less than 1 year. No gratuity is payable.
L.limitedNote: Limited contracts follow Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021.
L.unlimitedNote: Unlimited contracts follow legacy rules (Federal Law No. 8 of 1980). Resignation before 5 years results in reduced gratuity.
